evidence_slice: The Oxford Street Development Corporation (Establishment) Order 2025, UKSI 2025/1151, was made on 3 November 2025 and came into force on 1 January 2026. Article 2 defines the Mayoral development area as the area of land in Greater London shown bounded externally by the inside edge of the black line on the map referred to in the Order. Article 3 establishes the Oxford Street Development Corporation for that area. The official explanatory note states that the designated area encompasses Oxford Street and surrounding areas within the London boroughs of Camden and the City of Westminster.
